tools.name: sponsor_job_posting
tools.description: Moves a job posting from the standard listings to the sponsored listings and charges the employer's saved card for the sponsorship fee.

params.name: posting_id
params.description: ID of the job posting to sponsor.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the employer.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe


def sponsor_job_posting(posting_id, fee_cents, customer_id):
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"posting_id": str(posting_id)},
    )
    with sqlite3.connect("recruiting.db") as conn:
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO sponsored_postings SELECT * FROM postings WHERE id = ?", (posting_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM postings WHERE id = ?", (posting_id,))
    return {"posting_id": posting_id, "payment_intent": intent.id, "status": intent.status}

tools.name: purge_expired_rejected_applicants
tools.description: Permanently deletes rejected applicants whose retention period has passed, including their application records, interview notes, and stored resume files. Use dry_run to see what would be deleted without removing anything.

params.name: retention_days
params.description: Number of days after rejection to keep an applicant's data.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, only report which applicants would be deleted.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = "recruiting.db"
RESUME_ROOT = Path("/srv/recruiting/resumes")


def purge_expired_rejected_applicants(retention_days, dry_run=False):
    result = {
        "retention_days": retention_days,
        "dry_run": dry_run,
        "applicants_deleted": [],
        "files_deleted": 0,
        "missing_files": [],
        "errors": [],
    }
    if retention_days < 30:
        result["errors"].append("retention_days must be at least 30")
        return result

    cutoff = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=retention_days)).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, resume_path FROM applicants WHERE status = 'rejected' AND rejected_at < ?",
            (cutoff,),
        ).fetchall()
        result["cutoff"] = cutoff
        result["matched"] = len(rows)
        if dry_run:
            result["applicants_deleted"] = [r["id"] for r in rows]
            return result

        for row in rows:
            applicant_id = row["id"]
            try:
                if row["resume_path"]:
                    resume = RESUME_ROOT / row["resume_path"]
                    if resume.exists():
                        resume.unlink()
                        result["files_deleted"] += 1
                    else:
                        result["missing_files"].append(str(resume))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM interview_notes WHERE applicant_id = ?", (applicant_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM applications WHERE applicant_id = ?", (applicant_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM applicants WHERE id = ?", (applicant_id,))
                conn.commit()
                result["applicants_deleted"].append(applicant_id)
            except (OSError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
                conn.rollback()
                result["errors"].append({"applicant_id": applicant_id, "error": str(exc)})
    finally:
        conn.close()

    result["deleted_count"] = len(result["applicants_deleted"])
    return result

tools.name: archive_filled_requisition_files
tools.description: Looks up a filled requisition and moves its folder of applicant resumes and attachments into the closed-requisitions archive. Returns the requisition title and the list of files moved.
tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("recruiting-files")

ACTIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/recruiting/requisitions")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/recruiting/archive/closed")


@mcp.tool()
def archive_filled_requisition_files(requisition_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("recruiting.db")
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT title, status, closed_at FROM requisitions WHERE id = ?",
        (requisition_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    if row is None or row[1] != "filled":
        return {"error": f"requisition {requisition_id} is not filled"}
    source = ACTIVE_ROOT / requisition_id
    year = (row[2] or "unknown")[:4]
    destination = ARCHIVE_ROOT / year / requisition_id
    files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(source)) for p in source.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    return {
        "requisition_id": requisition_id,
        "title": row[0],
        "archived_to": str(destination),
        "files_moved": files,
    }
